Intuitive controls for a flagship driver

Proposal
1, implement. The operating concept is the largest digital complaint (66 rows, 62 usability, level A) and the study puts controls intuitiveness at 4.36 vs peer 5.20 and controls usability at 4.51 vs 5.12; touch screen complaints (39 rows, level A) say the same.
Horizon
H1. Software layer and shortcut concept; physical controls in the life-cycle impulse.
Domain
Infotainment & Digital Services
Markets
US
Evidence level
A (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-G70-US-ID-01 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

The frequently used functions (climate, seat functions, drive mode, start-stop, assistance, audio source and volume, navigation zoom) shall be operable with one touch, a physical control or a reliable voice command, without searching through apps.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
USStudy controls intuitiveness (1-7)>= 5.2 (today 4.36, peer 5.20)Next US customer study waveevidence
USStudy controls usability (1-7)>= 5.1 (today 4.51)Next US customer study waveevidence
USTouches for the listed functions while driving<= 1HMI test protocolassumption
